title: Check every Jackson feed from the unused public parser
description: On the parent and fixed Jackson Core 1415 JARs, compare the prior native checker with exact floating-point field capture at the unused parser returned by JsonFactory. For all 128 original schedules check the complete streamed trace, including closing offset, cursor, token count and EOF. Bind the literal dispatch and compare fresh JVM replays. Admit any native parent counterexample at the unchanged ordinary factory entry.
expected: Both revisions must reproduce all 128 physical traces and produce strict native before-and-after receipts. A replayed parent witness retains its typed input, original entry bytes, classpath and ordinary JVM observations.

steps.name: Measure the actual parser from factory return through close
